notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Indoraptor.
You have a way to deal exactly 1 damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor has toughness 2 or greater.
description:
Deal exactly 1 damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor, Rite of Passage and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Rite of Passage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Indoraptor.
Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to a random opponent unless they sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing 1 damage to Indoraptor.
Repeat from step 2.
